By way of the present application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the Applicant has prayed for enlarging the Applicant on anticipatory bail in connection with the C o m p l a i n t N o . 1 2 2 9 o f 2 0 2 4 d a t e d 2 6 . 1 0 . 2 0 2 4 filed wit h Sector 7 Police Station,
Gandhinagar f o r t h e o f f e n c e u n d e r S e c t i o n 4 0 6 a n d 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
2.
Heard learned Advocates for the respective parties.

3. Learned APP has drawn the attention of this Court that despite having been summoned by the Investigation Officer on several occasions, the Applicant has not remained present before the Investigation Officer and has thus not cooperated with the investigation.

sentences.text: 4. On the aforesaid statement made by the learned APP, the learned Advocate appearing for the Applicant submits that the Applicant shall remain NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/23686/2024 ORDER DATED: 12/12/2024 undefined present before the Investigation Officer on 16th December 2024.

5. Upon the statement being made at the bar by the learned Advocate for the Applicant, the Applicant, shall remain present before the Investigation Officer on 16th December 2024 and, after recording the statement of the Applicant, if the Investigation officer is desirous of arresting the Applicant, seven day's prior notice shall be given to the Applicant prior to his arrest.
6. The Application stands disposed of with the observation as aforesaid.
